labels.name: Diffuse type
labels.function: Large-joint form (often knee): pain, locking, recurrent swelling

labels.name: Localized type
labels.function: Discrete slow-growing painless nodule on a hand tendon sheath

labels.name: Osteoclast-like giant cell
labels.function: Multinucleated cell resembling the bone-resorbing cell

labels.name: Foamy macrophage
labels.function: Xanthomatous cell with bubbly, lipid-filled cytoplasm

labels.name: Hemosiderin-laden macrophage
labels.function: Phagocyte packed with brown iron-pigment granules

labels.name: Mononuclear synovial-like cell
labels.function: Proliferating single-nucleus cells that make up the nodules

labels.name: Chronic inflammatory cell
labels.function: Scattered small round immune cells among the tumor cells
